no unresolved transport or altered frozen engine

core.preservation_panel: Twelve old panel witnesses on a separate diagnostic descendant, no claim that panel was experienced by MAIN
core.minimum_previous_function: All seven language/contextual witnesses and all three signed FI witnesses available under a prospectively declared existing or generally substituted fixed access. Direct arithmetic two linked witnesses may remain partially unavailable only if explicitly delimited and compensated by causal useful information access. core.accepted_partial_loss: A direct-sum failure with correctly transported actual result is not global mathematical loss. If it persists, mark direct arithmetic unavailable in that domain, preserve prepared C2C if actually usable, and do not claim repaired memory. Acceptance requires at least one new useful Native-controlled conditional access whose information contribution is causally demonstrated.

new_gain.bounded_conditional_access: At least two materially applied questions, actual register samples including both physical direction codes, valid distinct Native second actions and useful actual function/products. In one matched material content contrast, same declared question schedule and opportunity family but informative vs noninformative/decoupled actual sample changes at least one later Native action and a useful outcome. No policy-competence or superiority claim follows.
new_gain.prospective_candidate_floor: At least8/12 combined useful outcomes across the twelve new opportunities, at least4/6 in the held-out final6, with complete denominators. If floor fails, no bounded-stage adoption from that cut; scientific partial remains.
new_gain.learned_query_claim: Requires history-dependent change specifically attributable to value of asking, separated from shared-bank second-stage return; not satisfied by changed query1 alone.
new_gain.transfer_scope: Last six pre-fixed new operand/wait/context opportunities are reserved; deterministic technical replay is reproduction, not independent replication.
new_gain.costs: Report Native input count, actual ticks, questions and useful FI/messages separately. Do not form an arbitrary common score. Both stages and opportunities remain prepared; marginal asking costs one material birth in the inherited device.

conditional_progression: After a sufficient adopted first milestone, continue only a descendant for additional persistent-environment exploration. Later failure does not overwrite validated principal.
